name: Josephine Lace
source:
The protagonist of Vengeful Heart. A hydraulic engineer at Nephys, Inc, working directly under its CEO, Francis Brabeck.

[spoiler]After being shot through the heart for organising a resistance against Nephys' forced purchase of her apartment block, she swears revenge on Nephys and Francis.[/spoiler]
